historical_record.description: The property held an existing two-story, two-family dwelling.

The City Planning Commission approved a conditional use authorization to demolish an existing two-story, two-family dwelling at 2020 Clement Street and construct a new four-story, 3-unit condominium building.

The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved demolition of the existing two-story, two-family dwelling at 2020 Clement Street, with conditions including a Notice of Special Restrictions.
The City Planning Commission took discretionary review and approved with modifications construction of a new four-story, 3-unit condominium building at 2020 Clement Street.
